title: 1. The Great Mystery (Hook)
text: Imagine floating in space. You see giant burning stars, completely frozen ice planets, and toxic gas giants. None of them can support life. And then, there is this one tiny, pale blue dot. Why is Earth the only place we know of where life exists?

title: 2. What do you think? (Socratic Thinking)
text: If you could design a brand new planet that allows humans, animals, and plants to survive, what three things would it absolutely need to have? Would it be close to a sun? Far away?

content.title: 3. The Perfect Distance (Discovery)
content.description: Notice how Earth is situated in the 'Goldilocks Zone' – not too hot like Venus, not too cold like Mars.

title: 4. Earth, the Unique Planet (Reveal)
text: Earth is unique because it has liquid water, an oxygen-rich atmosphere, and is located at an optimal distance from the Sun (the habitable zone), maintaining a temperature range suitable for life.

content.definition: The region around a star where conditions are right for liquid water to exist on a planet's surface.

content.question: Which of the following makes Earth capable of sustaining life?
options: Presence of liquid water and an atmosphere

title: 6. Your Turn (Reflection)
text: Explain to your younger sibling why we can't simply move to Mars tomorrow. What would we be missing there that we take for granted on Earth?

title: 7. Looking at the Bigger Picture (Connection)
text: This links to what we learned about the Solar System earlier, and it will be important later when we study how pollution threatens our perfect balance on Earth.

content.title: 8. Build a Biosphere (Mastery)
content.description: Design a closed terrarium using a glass jar, soil, a small plant, and water. Observe how the water cycle works on a micro level to sustain the plant, just like our Earth does for us!
